verses.verse:
मन्द्रपात् प्रथमस्यान्ते स्थाप्यताम् ऋजु धैवतः।
तत ऊर्ध्व द्वितीयान्ते शुद्ध धैवत इष्यते।50।
verses.text: From the mandra Pa, at the end of the first [half] let ṛju (komal) Dhaivata be placed; above that, at the end of the second, śuddha Dhaivata is wanted.

commentary.text: At the end of the first part from the bottom place komal Dhaivata, and at the end of the second, śuddha Dhaivata.
